data_fields.name: phase_duration_max_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: per phase, from appearance data (min equal to max means fixed)

data_fields.name: loop_count
data_fields.donor_constant: from appearance data; 0 wraps, n>0 counted, negative ping-pong

data_fields.name: timer_speed_factor
data_fields.donor_constant: max duration divided by speed factor (getSpeed())

best_idea: Give every instance its own clip clock with a random per-phase duration and carry the overrun into the next phase, so identical creatures and flipbook effects stop moving in lockstep while loops stay counted, ping-pong or hold-last.
decision_why: The per-instance clock, overrun carry, counted or ping-pong loops and random per-phase jitter fit creature idle variation and flipbook VFX in a browser client; the donor's synchronized resync draws twice and does not lock to a shared clock in normal play, so Frankendom writes it once, correctly, or drops it.
acceptance: Headless client test: a counted clip with loop count 2 plays two cycles then holds its last phase, and 20 instances of one creature with per-phase durations that differ are not all on the same phase after one cycle.
